lyrics:
[Intro: acoustic guitar strum, whistled riff]

[Verse 1: earnest male voice, guitar only]
Who pays the bill for the table that mocked him?
Who gives his coat to the fella that robbed him?
Who hears his name get dragged through the dirt
And says, "Put it on mine. Whatever it's worth."

[Pre-Chorus: building, snare roll]
I've known good people, I've known kind
I never knew one who'd cross that line

[Chorus: the drop, synth lead doubles the whistle]
Who does that? (Who does that?)
Who trades a throne for a hill and a tree?
Who does that? (Who does that?)
Who had it all and spent it on me?
Nobody I know, nobody I've met
Who does that?

[Verse 2: voice and guitar, kick drum under]
King of everything, born in a barn
Washed twelve pairs of feet with his own two arms
Could've called down fire, called it a day
Called out "Father, forgive them" instead, and stayed

[Pre-Chorus: building, snare roll]
I know his name now, I'll say it loud
Only one man in the whole wide crowd

[Chorus: the drop, crowd answers]
Jesus does that! (Jesus does that!)
He traded a throne for a hill and a tree
Jesus does that! (Jesus does that!)
He had it all and he spent it on me
Nobody else, nobody yet
Jesus does that

[Bridge: breakdown, handclaps, voices together]
I can't earn it, I can't pay it back
I can only stand here saying
Who does that?

[Final Chorus: biggest drop, everyone]
Jesus does that! (Jesus does that!)
He traded a throne for a hill and a tree
Jesus does that! (Jesus does that!)
He had it all and he spent it on me
Nobody else, nobody yet
Jesus does that

[Outro: whistled riff alone]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 126 BPM, 4/4, G major. A folk song that turns into a festival dance track and back.

VOICE: Male tenor, clear, high and sincere. Verses are intimate with only a guitar. In the choruses he sings the question and a crowd shouts it back. He sounds amazed, not preachy.

INSTRUMENTS: Strummed acoustic guitar, a whistled riff, a four-on-the-floor kick, a bright sawtooth synth lead that doubles the whistle after each chorus line, sidechained pads, snare rolls into each drop, handclaps, a piano in the bridge.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, guitar and whistle. 0:10 Verse 1. 0:32 Pre-chorus. 0:40 Chorus 1 and drop. 1:04 Verse 2, the king. 1:22 Pre-chorus. 1:30 Chorus 2, the answer. 1:56 Bridge, claps. 2:14 Final chorus and drop. 2:44 Outro, whistle alone, ends 3:06.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Early-2010s folk-EDM: acoustic and warm in the verses, wide and pumping in the drops, the whistle and synth playing the same tune.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The second drop at 1:30, when the question becomes an answer and the crowd shouts the name.

THE REVEAL: Verse 1 and the first chorus ask about a generosity nobody has seen. Verse 2 at 1:04 gives the barn, the foot-washing and the words from the cross; at 1:30 the same tune carries the answer.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Puzzled, amazed, certain, celebrating.
